coreContributionReading: A randomised test claiming a brief mindfulness app raises student wellbeing.

findings.claim: The reported programme-group mean of 8.40 lies outside the declared 1 to 7 WEMWBS scale range, an impossible result.
findings.failureScenario: A mean above the scale ceiling means the descriptive statistics and every inference built on them cannot be trusted as printed.
findings.leanestFix: Recompute the descriptive statistics from the raw item responses and correct either the scale range or the mean.

findings.claim: The significance claim at p = .03 is reported without the test statistic or degrees of freedom, so it cannot be checked.
findings.failureScenario: An unverifiable p-value cannot be screened for consistency against its statistic and degrees of freedom.
findings.leanestFix: Report the full test statistic, degrees of freedom, exact p-value, and effect size with its interval.

selfCritique.strongestObjection: If the stated 1 to 7 scale is a typo for a longer WEMWBS form, the mean would be plausible and the impossible-value finding would collapse.
confidenceRaisers: The Methods measure description and the raw item range to confirm the scale actually used.
